quotations.old_english: Scortlíce is hæbbe nú gesǽd hiora ingewinn
quotations.english: I have now shortly related their intestine struggles

source_text: in-gewinn, es ; n. An intestine struggle :-- Scortlíce is hæbbe nú gesǽd hiora ingewinn I have now shortly related their intestine struggles, Ors. 2, 6 ; Swt. 88, 29. [Cf. in-gefeoht.]
